what: A foggy map plate (three, 7×7) is tilted far forward (x −.35π · z .35π) and, from anywhere on screen, tilts toward the mouse by x .02 · z .03 rad, following 8% per frame. When the cursor is over the plate, that spot lights up as a round glow of radius .05 (turning on 12% at a time) and turns off when the cursor leaves the plate. Place pins are HTML, so points on the plate are projected to the screen every frame and tilt along with it, and an accent-color pillar stands at the home spot

options.min: Does not stick when the window is narrower than this width (px) (original 1121), default 0

note: Map graphic (data-fx-part="map" If there is no canvas or img), roads and blocks are drawn in skin colors (--fx-map-road·--fx-map-block, default --kf-ink-soft·--kf-line). The fog color is --kf-surface. When the panel is off screen, drawing pauses. three.cjs is loaded after three-global.js.
